statements:
findAssistedCandidate:
        this.database.prepare(`
          SELECT
            capture_candidates.id AS candidateId,
            products.id AS productId,
            products.name,
            products.source_url AS sourceUrl,
            products.affiliate_link AS affiliateLink
          FROM products
          INNER JOIN capture_candidates
            ON (
              capture_candidates.source_url = products.source_url
              OR (
                products.affiliate_link != ''
                AND capture_candidates.affiliate_link = products.affiliate_link
              )
              OR LOWER(TRIM(capture_candidates.name)) = LOWER(TRIM(products.name))
            )
          WHERE products.id = ?
            AND capture_candidates.status = 'Imported'
          ORDER BY capture_candidates.updated_at DESC
          LIMIT 1
        `),

      getAssistedMediaState:
        this.database.prepare(`
          SELECT
            candidate_id AS candidateId,
            status,
            expected_image_count AS expectedImageCount,
            downloaded_image_count AS downloadedImageCount,
            expected_video_count AS expectedVideoCount,
            downloaded_video_count AS downloadedVideoCount,
            video_status AS videoStatus,
            last_error AS lastError,
            updated_at AS updatedAt
          FROM candidate_media_state
          WHERE candidate_id = ?
          LIMIT 1
        `),
